patch_resolves_note: The staged `patch.diff` is unrelated to this lazychunk path, but the authoritative `n132/arvo:42490417-fix` image stays clean and its `blosc/frame.c` adds an upstream compressed-size sanity check in `get_header_info()` (`*nbytes > 0 && *cbytes == 0`) that rejects the malformed frame before `frame_get_lazychunk()` is reached.
verification_limitations: The frozen required assertion is anchored at the traced late root site in `frame_get_lazychunk()`. On the authoritative fixed original, execution stays clean by rejecting the malformed frame earlier in `get_header_info()`, so `lazychunk_offset_check` and `lazychunk_base` are not exercised there and the required assertion is not differentially verified.

nodes.description: When `blosc_getitem(coffsets, nchunk, 1, &offset)` fails, `get_coffset()` returns the negative sentinel `-4` instead of a real chunk offset.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `coffset_error_return.offset_return=-4` immediately before `get_coffset()` returns.

nodes.description: On the in-memory lazychunk path, `frame_get_lazychunk()` reuses the negative `offset` in `*chunk = frame->sdata + header_len + offset`, producing a chunk base pointer four bytes before `frame->sdata` on the witnessed execution.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `lazychunk_base.chunk_ptr=0xe9901e1c` and `lazychunk_base.frame_data_ptr=0xe9901e20`, so the computed chunk pointer precedes the start of the frame buffer.

nodes.description: The version-byte load at `_src[BLOSC2_CHUNK_VERSION]` executes with the same misbased lazychunk pointer as its `src` argument, so the sink dereferences memory before the fuzz-input region.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `version_read_sink.src_ptr=0xe9901e1c`, matching the misbased `lazychunk_base.chunk_ptr`.

edges.description: The exact negative sentinel returned by `get_coffset()` is the `offset` value later reused by the in-memory lazychunk pointer arithmetic in `frame_get_lazychunk()`.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `coffset_error_return.offset_return == lazychunk_base.offset_used == -4`.

edges.description: The misbased chunk pointer produced by `frame_get_lazychunk()` reaches `blosc_run_decompression_with_context()` unchanged as its `src` argument and is dereferenced immediately at the version-byte sink.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `lazychunk_base.chunk_ptr == version_read_sink.src_ptr`.

root_cause_criterion.criterion: After `int64_t offset = get_coffset(frame, header_len, cbytes, nchunk)` returns, the in-memory lazychunk path must reject negative offsets before executing `*chunk = frame->sdata + header_len + offset;`. Otherwise the `-4` error sentinel is reused as a byte offset and the resulting chunk base pointer can precede the frame buffer.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original reaches the lazychunk pointer-arithmetic site with `offset=-4`, so the missing nonnegative-offset check is violated while the protected chunk-base computation executes. The authoritative fixed original stays clean by failing earlier compressed-size validation in `get_header_info()`, so this late root event is not exercised there.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: Not runtime-verified on the authoritative fixed original case: `fixed_assertion_trace.txt` contains no `lazychunk_offset_check` event because the fixed image rejects the malformed frame earlier in `get_header_info()`.
